Installing it runs:

into the environment spaCR is running in. It downloads a large package and may change the installed version of torch, which can affect Cellpose and, in the worst case, stop spaCR starting. It can take several minutes; spaCR stays usable while it runs.

records.translation:
{name} 尚未安装。

安装时会在 spaCR 当前运行的环境中执行：
    pip install "{requirement}"

这会下载一个大型软件包，并可能更改已安装的 torch 版本，从而影响 Cellpose，最严重时会导致 spaCR 无法启动。安装可能需要几分钟，期间 spaCR 仍可使用。
